name: NitroBooth
author: bangorbuzz

sections.description:
NitroBooth gives independent photo-booth operators a focused request-to-book workflow inside WordPress. The free edition includes up to three services, a public booking-request form, blackout dates, lead and customer records, and a recent-inquiries view for a single administrator.

Use the [nitrobooth_booking] shortcode to add the form to a page.

NitroBooth Free does not create or publish WordPress pages automatically. It does not include add-ons, questionnaires, calendar subscriptions, staff accounts, or custom user roles.

External services

NitroBooth Free works without a NitroBooth account or external service. WordPress may send booking notifications using the mail configuration of the site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate NitroBooth.
  2. Open NitroBooth in the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Configure the business name and active service.
  4. Add [nitrobooth_booking] to a page.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • Establish the Free foundation used by the separately installed NitroBooth Pro add-on.
  • Support up to three bookable services.
  • Clarify manual page setup and the Free feature boundary.

short_description: Add a professional photo-booth inquiry form to WordPress, protect unavailable dates, and keep new leads organized.
